content:
**the read path finally measures the signed ADRs (#676 part 2)**

**Actor:** fix/issue-676-adr-0029-carries-675s-corruption-too-sig (agente)
**Fuente:** issue #676 / plainfiles save on vm

#676's own thesis is 'a rule enforced only on the write path does not measure the artefacts that are already there'. The ticket CLOSED with exactly that measurement unbuilt: PR #692 landed part 1 (the ADR-0029 repair, 0+ 3-) and its body said 'Closes #676 (part 1)' — the parenthetical is not part of GitHub's closing-keyword grammar, so the whole ticket closed. Reopened for part 2. Worth generalizing: a closing keyword cannot be scoped by prose, and #545 is the open ticket about that same parse family.

WHERE THE TEST LIVES, decided by measurement not preference: package.json 'files' ships brain/core and brain/scripts but NOT brain/project. A colocated brain/scripts/lib/*.test.mjs would therefore travel to consumers while its subject does not — a check whose surface excludes its subject, which is #674 inverted. It went to test/*.e2e.test.mjs, which ships to nobody (absent from 'files' AND from managed-paths.mjs), so its subject and its reach match.

THE HARD PART was not the sweep, it was proving a BORN-GREEN test bites without touching Tier 3. All 30 ADRs are well-formed since #692, so there is no natural red. Solution: readSignedAdrs(dir = DECISIONS_DIR) — a seam signedAdrNumbers already carries — lets arm A drive the whole pipeline off a mkdtemp fixture dir (two-in-preamble, two-in-body, zero, and a one-Status control that must never be flagged), and arm B splices a second Status line into REAL ADR bytes in memory, zero writes. Arm C (mutating a real file in the working tree) is Tier 2 and stays a human's one-time round — apply stopped and did not check its box.

Note the tier reading that survived scrutiny: agent-authorities.md prohibits COMMITTING to brain/project/** (Tier 3); MODIFYING files under brain/ is Tier 2. A transient working-tree write is Tier 2, one 'git add -A' from Tier 3 — not forbidden, but unrepeatable and gone after the revert, which is a poor home for the only evidence a guard bites.

DESIGN CALL worth keeping: one sweep test, NOT a subtest per ADR. Per-ADR subtests give precise failure names but a broken enumerator registers ZERO tests, and node --test reports zero tests as a PASS. The shape with the nicer failure names is the shape that fails silently. The precision moved into renderOffenders instead.

GOTCHA found after apply reported done: the vacuity guard borrowed the repo's real test/fixtures dir (package-manager fixtures) to get 'a directory with no ADR'. Every failure mode of that is red, not silently green — but it would go red for a reason unrelated to the invariant. Now it mkdtemps its own.

Verify re-ran the mutations independently rather than trusting apply: blind the detector -> red; reader returns [] instead of throwing -> red; reader ignores its dir argument -> red (this is the one that proves arm A is not vacuous); DECISIONS_DIR pointed at a nonexistent path -> red, sanity floor first. 3826/3826 green.

**Where:** test/adr-status-line-single.e2e.test.mjs, openspec/changes/issue-676-adr-structural-invariant/
